name: settlemint
description: Split expenses, not friendships: a web app, phone app and API for sharing costs in any currency.
author: Umair <https://github.com/umair363>

scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w @settlemint/client && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w mobile
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w api
scripts.dev:v1: npm run build:shared && npm run dev:v1 -w api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w web
